BR-CL-23.plain_text: A unit of measure on the invoice lines uses a code that is not on the official UN/ECE list (Recommendation 20, with the Recommendation 21 extension). Receiving systems cannot tell reliably what unit the quantity is in.
BR-CL-23.fix_hint: Ask the supplier to use standard UN/ECE unit codes on every line, for example C62 (one) or HUR (hour), and to resend the invoice.

BR-DE-15.plain_text: The buyer reference (BT-10) is missing. XRechnung requires it on every invoice. It is the reference you gave the supplier for routing the invoice, such as a Leitweg-ID or an internal order or cost-centre reference.
BR-DE-15.fix_hint: Ask the supplier to resend the invoice with your buyer reference filled in, for example your Leitweg-ID or purchase reference.

BR-DE-TMP-32.plain_text: The invoice does not say when the goods were delivered or the service was performed: it has no delivery date (BT-72), no invoicing period (BG-14) and no period on every line (BG-26). XRechnung recommends one of them. This is a hint, not an error.
BR-DE-TMP-32.fix_hint: If you need the delivery or service date, ask the supplier to include a delivery date or an invoicing period in the invoice.

BR-IC-11.plain_text: The invoice uses the VAT category for intra-community supplies, but gives neither the actual delivery date (BT-72) nor an invoicing period (BG-14). EN 16931 requires one of them for this VAT category.
BR-IC-11.fix_hint: Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice that states the delivery date or the invoicing period.

BR-IC-12.plain_text: The invoice uses the VAT category for intra-community supplies, but does not say which country the goods were delivered to (BT-80). EN 16931 requires the delivery country for this VAT category.
BR-IC-12.fix_hint: Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice that includes the delivery address with its country.

BR-S-02.plain_text: At least one line is charged at the standard VAT rate, but the invoice gives no VAT ID or tax number for the seller (BT-31, BT-32) and no VAT ID of a tax representative (BT-63). EN 16931 requires at least one of them.
BR-S-02.fix_hint: Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice that includes their VAT ID or tax number.

CII-DT-031.plain_text: Amounts in the XML carry a currency attribute (currencyID) where the CII format for EN 16931 does not allow one; only the tax total may have it. This is a technical error in how the file is built; it does not say the amounts are wrong.
CII-DT-031.fix_hint: Ask the supplier to have their invoicing software fixed so it produces a valid EN 16931 file, and to resend this invoice.

CII-SR-002.plain_text: The XML contains a test indicator (TestIndicator), which EN 16931 invoices should not include. It can mean that the file was created in a test mode of the supplier's software.
CII-SR-002.fix_hint: Ask the supplier to confirm that this is a real invoice and not a test, and to leave the test indicator out in future.

CII-SR-013.plain_text: The document header contains a document name (Name), which EN 16931 invoices should not include. It is extra information that receiving systems may ignore; the invoice data itself is not affected by this finding.
CII-SR-013.fix_hint: Usually nothing. You may ask the supplier to stop sending the document name, which EN 16931 does not use.

CII-SR-122.plain_text: A line's gross price carries a discount given as a percentage (CalculationPercent), which EN 16931 invoices should not include. Receiving systems may ignore the percentage and use only the discount amount.
CII-SR-122.fix_hint: Usually nothing. If a line price looks wrong, ask the supplier to state price discounts as amounts only.

CII-SR-123.plain_text: A line's gross price discount carries a base amount (BasisAmount), which EN 16931 invoices should not include. Receiving systems may ignore it and use only the discount amount.
CII-SR-123.fix_hint: Usually nothing. If a line price looks wrong, ask the supplier to state price discounts as amounts only.

XSD.plain_text: The XML file does not follow the official schema of its format (UBL or CII): an element is missing, in the wrong place or not allowed. Because the structure is broken, the invoice's content rules could not be checked.
XSD.fix_hint: Ask the supplier to resend the invoice as a valid XML file; their invoicing software produced a file that breaks the format's schema.
